datasets.name: ReserveInf
datasets.sql:
select 
   p.numberofcredit,
    lacc.acc_no as loanaccno,
    cust.name,ct.description,f.name filial,
    p.dateofconclusion,
    p.duedatefirstcontract,v.val_name,
    p.duedatelastcontract,psh.odemeli_faiz,
    psh.planrest, (select (select name  from cust_quality where id=quality_id) from customers where id=p.BOOROWERID) kefiyet,
    h.rest,(h.interestrest-(select cm_common.OutAccountRest_Get(outinterestaccid) from cm_accounts
where creditid=p.id) )interestrest,(h.interestrest-(select cm_common.OutAccountRest_Get(outinterestaccid) from cm_accounts
where creditid=p.id) )*ok.ostat as ekv_intrest,h.PENALTYREST,pl.name as grovname,
    h.rest*ok.ostat as ekrest,h.stopcalcdate,    h.duerest,h.dueinterestrest,h.dueinterestrest*ok.ostat ekgecfaiz,
    h.duerest*ok.ostat as ekduerest, g.REGISTRYNO,    h.pledgeprice,h.reserveintrest,
    trunc(h.pledgeprice/decode(h.rest*ok.ostat+h.duerest*ok.ostat,0,1,h.rest*ok.ostat+h.duerest*ok.ostat),2)*100 as pl,
    restype.PERCENT as respercent ,duerestype.PERCENT as duerespercent ,
    (h.rest*ok.ostat+h.duerest*ok.ostat)*restype.PERCENT/100  as resostat,p.numberofbankcredit,
    restype.description ehname ,duerestype.description gecehname 
from
   cm_portfolio p,filial_t f,avalute_t v,
   cm_loanaccounts lacc,
   customers cust,
   cm_history h,cm_credittypes ct,
   cm_reserve_types restype, cm_reserve_types duerestype,
   sb_operkurs ok,cm_pledgsorts pl,cm_guarantee g ,


(SELECT  creditid, rest as planrest,interest as odemeli_faiz
  FROM cm_payment_schedule where paymentdate = :dat
  union
   select  creditid , 0 as planrest,0 as odemeli_faiz  
 from 
  (select id as creditid 
  from cm_portfolio
  minus
  SELECT  creditid
  FROM cm_payment_schedule where paymentdate = :dat)) psh

where p.id = lacc.creditid  and
      p.boorowerid = cust.id and
      p.id = h.creditid and
      h.hdate = :dat and 
      p.id = psh.creditid and p.branchid=f.id and
      h.reserveid = restype.id and
      h.duereserveid = duerestype.id and
      p.currency = ok.val_kod and
      p.currency = v.valute and
      p.CREDITTYPE=ct.id     and g.pledgsorts=pl.id(+) and g.creditid(+)=p.id  AND 
      ok.dat = :dat

datasets.name: DatSetReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, description||' - '||PERCENT as description
  FROM cm_reserves
